sections.heading: C2 — KG handoff hints — Sec 11
sections.markdown:
## C2 — KG handoff — Sec 11 Distractions/challenges

FACT_ID: sec11-R01 | anchor: A01
A sudden in-car distraction should be handled by pulling off the road and stopping before dealing with it [A01].
Why it matters: group distraction-response; prereq none; difficulty 1; confusable sec11-R05.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec11-R02 | anchor: A01
Aggressive driving endangers others with moving violations, while road rage adds criminal intent to endanger or intimidate on a roadway [A01].
Why it matters: group aggressive-vs-rage; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec11-R01.
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0066]

FACT_ID: sec11-R03 | anchor: A02
Near the roadway, watch far ahead and at the sides, slow down, stay in the lane, and never swerve for an animal [A02].
Why it matters: group animal-avoidance; prereq none; difficulty 1; confusable sec11-R08.
Source: [A02 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec11-R04 | anchor: A03
Floodwater that looks shallow can hide dips and washouts, so turn around rather than crossing a flooded road [A03].
Why it matters: group flood-response; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec11-R09.
Source: [A03 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0068]

FACT_ID: sec11-R05 | anchor: A04
Drivers over eighteen may talk hands-free with voice commands, while younger drivers may use a device only for emergencies [A04].
Why it matters: group device-rules; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec11-R06.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec11-R06 | anchor: A04
A texting offense is a lower misdemeanor with a fine, rising to a higher misdemeanor with injury or a prior offense [A04].
Why it matters: group penalties; prereq sec11-R05; difficulty 2; confusable sec11-R07.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec11-R07 | anchor: A04
Work zones use orange signs and devices, and speeding there draws at least double the normal fine [A04].
Why it matters: group work-zones; prereq none; difficulty 1; confusable sec11-R06.
Source: [A04 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0069]

FACT_ID: sec11-R08 | anchor: A05
On a narrow downhill stretch yield to vehicles climbing uphill, stay right, and never coast in neutral [A05].
Why it matters: group mountain-driving; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec11-R03.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec11-R09 | anchor: A05
Dim high beams before closing near oncoming traffic or when following closely behind another vehicle [A05].
Why it matters: group night-visibility; prereq none; difficulty 2; confusable sec11-R04.
Source: [A05 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0070]

FACT_ID: sec11-R10 | anchor: A07
If the rear slides right, steer right, if it slides left, steer left, ease off gas, avoid hard braking, then straighten [A07].
Why it matters: group skid-recovery; prereq none; difficulty 3; confusable sec11-R08.
Source: [A07 -> src:rdmv-ut-class-d:utah-dld:handbook:pdf-0072]
